subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: Should Feishu form/select/input card callbacks expose a structured JSON synthetic message, or stay command-compatible by encoding extra fields around the existing text fallback?
rationale: The branch chooses structured JSON for form-data paths, while current command-style card handling is compatibility-sensitive and related reviews flagged this payload-shape choice as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Command-compatible field preservation
options.body: Preserve slash-command behavior and add the extra fields through the current parser/fallback contract in a documented, tested shape.

options.title: Structured JSON payload
options.body: Accept JSON synthetic messages for form/select/input callbacks and document that downstream handlers must parse that payload.

options.title: Ask for a fresh PR
options.body: Treat this branch as too stale after the proof window and ask for a current-main replacement with live proof.

recommendation.title: Command-compatible field preservation
recommendation.body: Preserve slash-command behavior and add the extra fields through the current parser/fallback contract in a documented, tested shape.
